R1.5a + R1.5a-fix - Phase 3a CLOSED: ProofProtectionEngine (proven; profitability deferred)

First real trade-management engine, wired contract -> coordinator -> policy ->
real broker modify, plus the R1.5a-fix structural-stop correction.

Engine stack:
- CFalconProofProtectionEngine (thin) + swappable CFalconProtectionPolicy +
  CFalconFixedRMultipleProtection (arms once at Trigger x R, moves stop to
  entry +/- offset, one-direction guard never walks the stop back).
- Coordinator MODIFY_SL apply path issues a real TRADE_ACTION_SLTP modify;
  NO_ACTION touches nothing; CLOSE/PARTIAL_CLOSE remain UNSUPPORTED (3b/3c).

R1.5a-fix (the reason R1.5a never armed):
- R is now sized from the strategy structural stop, not the broker SL. The
  broker SL is the wide LOCK-parity emergency envelope (~3x structural / USD
  capped); sizing R off it inflated R 30-500x so the engine never armed
  (backlog #76). New double structural_stop_price on FalconManagedPositionContext;
  carried entry->coordinator via g_structural_stop_registry
  (position_ticket -> structural_stop_price), recorded at S01 entry-accept and
  cleared on close (additive bookkeeping; entry/exit logic untouched). Policy
  disarms safely when the field is 0.0.
- Unchanged: arming rule, thresholds, stop destination, one-direction guard,
  engine/policy signatures, inputs (none added), emergency envelope, S01/bridge
  entry-exit, Apply* chain.

Build: 0 errors, 0 warnings. EA_VERSION_TAG=R1_5a_fix, EA_BUILD_TAG=ProofProtectionEngineFix.

Verdict: engine mechanically PROVEN (arms, real broker SL_MODIFIED, guard holds,
R realistic in tens of points, deterministic). Profitability NOT judgeable on the
S01 harness (no real edge): 4-month sweep 2026.02.01->2026.05.25 ($1000)
BrokerActualNetUSD OFF -145.07, trig1.5 -161.30, trig2.0 -223.61 -- no value beats
OFF, months contradict. Deferred to re-evaluation on a real edge-having strategy.
Enable_S01_Protection stays false by default (layer inert at baseline).
